incidents.text: An amazing individual effort from Mateo Chavez Garcia (Mexico) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:1. Matej Kovar was helpless.
The referee signals a substitution. Lukas Provod (Czech Republic) is brought on as a substitute for Denis Visinsky.
Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Julian Quinones (Mexico), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:2.
Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Guillermo Martinez Ayala is replaced by Santiago Gimenez (Mexico).
Substitution. Luis Romo walks off the pitch and Obed Vargas (Mexico) comes on as a substitute.
Yael Perez shows a yellow card to Edson Alvarez (Mexico), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
Substitution. Adam Hlozek makes way for Patrik Schick (Czech Republic).
Here is a change. Tomas Holes is going off and Miroslav Koubek gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic).
It will be a substitution. Alvaro Fidalgo (Mexico) is ready to enter the pitch as Gilberto Mora walks off.
That's the end of the game for Raul Rangel, who is replaced by Guillermo Ochoa (Mexico).
Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Mateo Chavez Garcia and he is replaced by Jesus Gallardo (Mexico).
Substitution. Lukas Cerv did his best and is replaced by Tomas Chory (Czech Republic).
Miroslav Koubek is forced to make a change. Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Alexandr Sojka.
Alvaro Fidalgo (Mexico) receives a precise pass inside the box from Roberto Alvarado and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the left side of the net. 0:3.
